source_title: Mckenna Grace Says Filming Hunger Games Took a Toll — So She Reached Out to Josh Hutcherson: ‘This Is Crazy’ (Exclusive) - People.com
source_excerpt:
Grace stars as twins Maysilee and Merrilee Donner in the new prequel, ‘Sunrise on the Reaping,’ in theaters Nov. 20
Mckenna Grace says she reached out to her former costar Josh Hutcherson to hear stories about his time shooting Hunger Games
The actress plays District 12 twins Maysilee and Merrilee Donner alongside Joseph Zada’s young Haymitch in the new prequel
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping releases in theaters Nov. 20
Mckenna Grace had a helpful hand to call on during particularly difficult set days while shooting the latest Hunger Games prequel, Sunrise on the Reaping .
After costarring in 2025’s Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 together, Grace, 20, counts Hunger Games alum Josh Hutcherson a friend. And the actor, who starred as Peeta in the original series alongside Jennifer Lawrence as its rebellious lead Katniss, knows a thing or two about the physical and emotional demands of the role.
“Eventually after I booked the film and I was shooting, I reached out to him and we spoke and I was like, ‘Were your games, did it feel as physically taxing and emotionally?’ ” Grace tells PEOPLE in this week’s issue, explaining that her body couldn’t tell the difference between the “trauma” it faced in the arena as her character is hunted to death for sport and real life.
Alan Chapman/Dave Benett/WireImage;Savion Washington/FilmMagic
“I was like, ‘This is crazy.’ And he was like, ‘Yeah. Yeah, no, they’re all like that. It’s definitely hard,’ ” Grace says of his response.
The actress admits she wasn’t necessarily seeking advice from Hutcherson, 34, so much as she “just wanted stories” as a major fan of the series (she famously has posted fan edits).
Hutcherson and Lawrence, 36, played the star-crossed lovers from District 12 in the four original movies, which were released between 2012 and 2015. Grace is now starring as twins Maysilee and Merrilee Donner, the former of whom is picked as a District 12 tribute in the first Quarter Quell alongside a young Haymitch ( Joseph Zada ).
“I wanted to know what their games were like and also what Jen and Josh were like at our age, and the fun that they had on those movies and what it was like working in the water on Catching Fire , ” Grace says.
In Catching Fire , the second movie in the series, Hutcherson and Lawrence faced their second Hunger Games together, in which they were up against an environmentally dangerous arena as well as double the number of tributes.
“He was like, ‘That stuff was intense and brutal, and you’d get up so early and be in this freezing water,’ ” the actress recalls. “And so I definitely got to hear some stories that were so fun and so cool. But yeah, that was more my focus as the resident kind of fangirl on this project was just trying to get stories versus advice, which was probably not the best course of action.”
In addition to Grace and Zada, 21, Sunrise on the Reaping features a stacked cast including Ralph Fiennes , Kieran Culkin , Glenn Close and Elle Fanning , many of whom play the younger versions of characters introduced in the original series.
Lawrence and Hutcherson will also reprise their roles for a brief cameo.
